description: This Java source file defines the AlarmUtil class, a utility class for scheduling, canceling, and managing alarms using Android's AlarmManager. It includes methods for setting alarms, canceling them, calculating the next alarm time, and reading/writing alarm data to Bundles.

classes.name: AlarmUtil
classes.description: Utility class for scheduling and managing alarms in Android.

methods.name: AlarmUtil
methods.description: Constructor that initializes AlarmUtil with a Context and retrieves the AlarmManager service.

methods.name: scheduleAlarm
methods.description: Schedules an alarm using AlarmManager with specified alarm details.

methods.name: getNextAlarmTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns the next alarm time as a Calendar object based on provided hour and minute.

methods.name: readAlarm
methods.description: Reads alarm data from a Bundle and returns an Alarm object.

methods.name: writeAlarm
methods.description: Writes alarm data into a Bundle from an Alarm object.
